tasks.subject: Fix cooldown anchor: only auth failures set it (piholeClient.ts)
tasks.description: Copilot review #1: login cooldown anchor is set for ALL failed logins including FtlConnectionError (unreachable FTL). After a transient network outage, requests within cooldown throw FtlAuthError → route reports 503 auth_failed instead of retrying and reporting 502. Only FtlAuthError (real auth failures) should set the cooldown anchor. Lines ~121, 157, 235 in src/lib/piholeClient.ts.

tasks.subject: Map/validate config failures (proxyClient.ts / hooks)
tasks.description: Copilot review #2: createPiholeClient() → loadConfig() throws plain Error (missing password / bad timeout); route only maps FtlAuthError/FtlConnectionError → unhandled 500. Lazy creation means /health stays green and container doesn't fail fast as documented. Fix: fail-fast at boot in production (hooks.server.ts module-level check) and/or map config errors to 503 config_error in the route.

tasks.subject: Fix stale-response race in filterlist tab switching
tasks.description: Copilot review #3: a request started for the previous list can resolve after the new list's request and assign stale `domains` (deny tab selected but allow entries shown). Fix with a generation token (or AbortController) — ignore stale responses before updating state. Lines ~44, 55 in src/routes/filterlist/+page.svelte.

tasks.subject: Resolve enable-toggle claim: implement or remove
tasks.description: Copilot review #4: `enabled` renders read-only; PR description promises a per-domain enable toggle. Check official FTL v6 docs for the exact-domain enable endpoint; if it exists, implement (allowlist + api client + UI control + tests). Otherwise remove the claim from the PR description.

tasks.subject: Fix 'SSegoe UI' font typo in app.css
tasks.description: Copilot review #5: line 90 of src/app.css has `SSegoe UI` typo → systems with Segoe UI installed skip it. Correct to `Segoe UI`.
